item: Can be placed into a bauble slot

releases.notes:
## Added
* Support for more decorative blocks from Primal
* Option to disable block breaking with an empty hand (only applicable to bauble usage)

## Changed
* Updated Russian localization
* Show break area size + hint tooltip when breaking with empty hand

## Fixed
* Tool doesn't work with break/place keybinds set to keyboard keys instead of mouse buttons
* NTM breaks default keybind cancelling, causing blocks to be placed/broken when the tool should be handling it
* Inventory Bogo Sorter hotbar swapping activates incorrectly after the gui closes


## PRs in this release
* Updated Russian localization by @TheVitya2127 in https://github.com/MellowArpeggiation/Effortless-Building-Gadgets/pull/7


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MellowArpeggiation/Effortless-Building-Gadgets/compare/0.9.3...0.10.0
